maudhui: (1) The Vice-President shall assume office on the same day that the President assumes office. (2) A Vice-President appointed in accordance with Article 50(4) shall take the oath and assume office after his appointment has been confirmed by the National Assembly.
vifungu: (1) The Vice-President shall assume office on the same day that the President assumes office.
(2) A Vice-President appointed in accordance with Article 50(4) shall take the oath and assume office after his appointment has been confirmed by the National Assembly.
